title: Adversarial ML Lab evaluation case row (v1)
description: One JSONL row in an evaluation dataset. Fail-closed: unknown properties and type violations reject the entire load.

case_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this case within the dataset (snake_case).

prompt.description: User-facing prompt text presented to the defended LLM pipeline.

context.description: Surrounding context (history, RAG, or document body) bundled with the prompt.

task_type.description: Evaluator routing label (e.g. chat, summarize, classify).

expected_blocked.description: Whether the defense should block this case (ground-truth label).

case_type.description: High-level case classification; must be listed in the dataset manifest allowed_case_types.

attack_family.description: Attack or scenario family name used for family_counts aggregation in the manifest.

expected_review.description: Whether human review is expected for a correct outcome.

expected_risk_level.description: Expected risk tier; must be listed in the dataset manifest allowed_risk_levels.

notes.description: Free-form author notes; not used in scoring.
